These four Invoice Statement CSVs were filed 15/09/2026 20:36-20:40 UTC by michael@makiramen.com. gmv = sum of the order-level 'Order Value (GBP)' column over the 'Orders and related adjustments' section, produced by builders/pull_deliveroo_invoices.py. Order dates verified 2026-09-07..2026-09-13; no unrecognised storefronts. Activity mix: Delivery 211, Pickup 2. Script said 381 orders (aov 18.32) against a real 213 (aov 32.77) - 173 blank-Order-Value adjustment rows, the worst instance of the bug in this batch. issues: Significant Char Siu wastage caused by supplier size inconsistency is pushing food cost up.
The deep fryer is leaking from the back; it was too hot to inspect when first found and is being checked again.
The bar renovation is a high priority maintenance job awaiting an update, and the ice machine is high priority and due to be purchased this week.
No bad reviews were received in the week.
Deliveroo prep time showed no improvement, with sushi delays at weekends the identified cause.
Four Deliveroo missing item claims were disputed and three were accepted.
Two team members returned from holiday, another is scheduled for holiday at the end of the month, and the rota is otherwise covered for the next two weeks.
A team member left the business, with their last day the day after the meeting.
Trade was very quiet on weekdays and busy at the weekend, helped by the Manchester derby on the Sunday.

Region-wide (England): The prep level list in the daily Mapal chef report is being replaced by a nightly main protein stock count, recorded on a printed sheet in the kitchen and photographed and uploaded to Mapal every night by whoever closes.

Region-wide (England): The AI daily stock ordering dashboard is only as accurate as the daily stock counts and timely invoice entry into Kobas, and two sites this week showed false shortage flags caused by invoice upload lag.
Region-wide (England): Operations is sourcing a new Char Siu and karaage manufacturer after supplier size inconsistency drove wastage and food cost.
An AGM, Caitlin, starts at the site next week.
North England cluster: The first Back to Basics brand standards training session was delivered and all managers are now aware of the site presentation standards.
